steps.label: Pick a piece
steps.goal: a piece in hand follows the pointer, so you see where it will land before you put it down
do: click any piece in the palette on the left
steps.recovery: if the palette is empty, add some meshes first: File, then Add meshes

steps.label: Place it
steps.goal: a click on the ground puts the piece down, and you can keep clicking to place more
do: click the floor of the map
steps.recovery: a click over the interface places nothing, so aim at the ground and not at a panel

steps.label: Turn it
steps.goal: R turns a piece and T turns it the other way, so walls and furniture can face any way
do: it turns the piece in hand, or the piece under the pointer when your hand is empty
steps.recovery: if a text field has the keyboard, press Escape first

steps.label: Save the map
steps.goal: your edit lives in memory until you save, and the status bar says when it is written
do: press Ctrl+S, or Cmd+S on a Mac
steps.recovery: if the save is refused, the status bar says why
